description: This file is a Kotlin source file defining an Android Fragment called HomeFragment. It constructs the UI for the Android TV home page, including navigation, 'Seguí viendo' content, and TV channels rails. The fragment manages RecyclerViews for horizontal scrolling of navigation items, movies, and TV channels, with focus and navigation handling tailored for TV remote control.

classes.name: MovieCard
classes.description: Data class representing a movie card in the 'Seguí viendo' rail, including title, image resource, and progress percentage.

classes.name: TvChannelCard
classes.description: Data class representing a TV channel card in the 'Canales de TV' rail, including title, channel info, time, image resource, live status, progress, and rental tag flag.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment's layout from XML.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes UI components after view creation, setting up navigation and content rails.

methods.name: setupNavigationBar
methods.description: Configures the horizontal navigation bar, including adapter setup and focus handling.

methods.name: setupContinueWatchingRail
methods.description: Sets up the 'Seguí viendo' horizontal content rail with a list of movies.

methods.name: setupTvChannelsRail
methods.description: Sets up the TV channels rail with channel cards.
